bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 × 8 × 6 inches, diaper bags and medical bags may enter after search. Backpacks, boxes, laptop bags and briefcases are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The theater does not manage parking; public paid parking is available in VCU decks within two blocks, which open three hours before showtime and operate cashlessly.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Altria Theater visitor FAQ and directions page do not specify a dedicated rideshare pickup location.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Cashless concessions sell popcorn, candy, snacks, soft drinks, beer, wine and mixed drinks on all levels except the fourth floor. Outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible entrances are on North Laurel Street and West Main Street; elevators serve all levels and accessible restrooms are in the main lobby. Assisted-listening devices are available with a photo ID deposit.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The theater FAQ mentions a designated outdoor smoking area but does not publish a general re-entry rule for concerts.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call tickets may be picked up at the venue box office starting two hours before the advertised showtime; bring valid photo ID.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The lobbies generally open one hour before the event and seating-area doors may open only 30 minutes before it. Entry can include metal detection and a bag search.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
